dcterms:description: A dataset characterized by noisy periodicity, higher dimensionality, and correlated features, consisting of multivariate, continuous-valued measurements including numerous temporal features measured at close intervals.
dcterms:title: UCI Appliances Energy Prediction Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of sequences of stock prices, which are continuous-valued but aperiodic, including features such as volume and high, low, opening, closing, and adjusted closing prices.
dcterms:title: Google Stocks Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of multivariate sinusoidal sequences of different frequencies and phases, providing continuous-valued, periodic, multivariate data where each feature is independent of others.
dcterms:title: Sines Dataset

dcterms:description: A large private lung cancer pathways dataset consisting of sequences of events and their times, modeling both the one-hot encoded sequence of event types as well as the event timings.
dcterms:title: Lung Cancer Pathways Dataset
